result.instructions: Tools for Codecov, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Codecov data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run codecov_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run codecov_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run codecov_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. codecov_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: codecov_list_service_owners
tools.title: List service owners
tools.description: List owners (organizations/users) the token can see on a git service. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/.

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (maps to `page_size`).
